Class IntellijMaven

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.maven.IntellijMaven
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class IntellijMaven extends AnahataToolkit
A toolkit for inspecting and building Maven projects through the IntelliJ IDEA Maven integration.

This is the IntelliJ port of the NetBeans Maven toolkit. It uses MavenProjectsManager to enumerate imported Maven projects and their resolved dependencies, and MavenRunner to execute goals against a project's live configuration. Goal execution is asynchronous in the platform; this toolkit awaits completion on a latch so the model receives a definitive result. Build output streams to the IDE's Maven Run console (the platform does not expose it as a return value here).

anahata

    • runGoals

      public MavenBuildResult runGoals(String projectPath, List<String> goals, List<String> profiles, Map<String,String> properties, List<String> options, Boolean skipTests, String vmOptions, Integer timeoutSeconds) throws AgiToolException
      Executes Maven goals against a project synchronously, streaming stdout/stderr to the tool logs, saving the full untruncated log file to disk, and returning a structured MavenBuildResult.
      Parameters:
      projectPath - the absolute path of the Maven project directory or its pom.xml.
      goals - the Maven goals to run (e.g. ['clean', 'package']).
      profiles - the profiles to activate, or null/empty for none.
      properties - a map of custom properties to set (-Dkey=value).
      options - a list of additional command-line options (e.g. ['-X', '-U', '--offline']).
      skipTests - whether to skip tests (-DskipTests). Defaults to false.
      vmOptions - JVM options for the runner (e.g. '-Xmx2048m').
      timeoutSeconds - the maximum time to wait for the build to complete, in seconds (default 900).
      Returns:
      a MavenBuildResult containing execution status, exit code, output, error, and log file path.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if the project cannot be resolved.

    • searchMaven

      public MavenSearchReport searchMaven(String query, String groupId, String artifactId, Boolean includeAllVersions, Boolean stableOnly, Integer startIndex, Integer pageSize) throws AgiToolException
      Unified search across Maven repositories and indices with coordinate navigation, version resolution, and stability filtering.

      Supports three complementary lookup modes:

      • Exact Coordinate Resolution: Supplying both groupId and artifactId resolves all indexed versions instantly in 0 ms.
      • Group Navigation: Supplying groupId without a keyword query resolves all artifacts belonging to that group.
      • Keyword Search: Searching via query matches against indexed group and artifact IDs, grouping all matching versions under consolidated artifact records.
      Parameters:
      query - keyword query matched against groupId and artifactId (e.g. 'junit-jupiter' or 'lombok').
      groupId - exact groupId filter or navigation (e.g. 'org.junit.jupiter').
      artifactId - exact artifactId filter (e.g. 'junit-jupiter-api').
      includeAllVersions - whether to include all indexed versions for each artifact (sorted newest first). Defaults to false (latest only).
      stableOnly - whether to filter out pre-releases (alpha, beta, rc, milestone, snapshots). Defaults to true.
      startIndex - starting index for pagination (0-based). Defaults to 0.
      pageSize - maximum number of artifacts to return. Defaults to 25.
      Returns:
      a MavenSearchReport containing matched artifacts, version metadata, and pagination info.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if no open project is available to query against.

    • addDependency

      public AddDependencyResult addDependency(String projectPath, String groupId, String artifactId, String version, String scope, String classifier, String type, String beforeDependency, String afterDependency, String comment)
      The definitive 'super-tool' for adding a Maven dependency to a project's pom.xml.

      This tool follows a safe, multi-phase process:

      1. Pre-flight: Verifies artifact existence and resolves property expressions like ${project.version} or dependencyManagement.
      2. Modification: Atomically adds the dependency to the project's pom.xml using IntelliJ's native MavenDomProjectModel, with optional relative positioning and comments.
      3. Resolution: Runs dependency:resolve to ensure transitive dependencies are satisfied.
      4. Background: Triggers asynchronous download of sources and javadocs.

      Finally, it triggers an IntelliJ Maven project reload to reflect changes in the IDE.

      Parameters:
      projectPath - the absolute path of the project directory or its pom.xml.
      groupId - the dependency groupId.
      artifactId - the dependency artifactId.
      version - the version of the dependency (supports property expressions like '${project.version}', or null if managed by dependencyManagement).
      scope - the scope of the dependency (e.g. 'compile', 'test'). Defaults to 'compile'.
      classifier - the classifier of the dependency (e.g. 'sources'). Can be null.
      type - the type of the dependency (e.g. 'test-jar'). Defaults to 'jar'.
      beforeDependency - optional artifactId of an existing dependency to insert this dependency BEFORE.
      afterDependency - optional artifactId of an existing dependency to insert this dependency AFTER.
      comment - optional descriptive XML comment to place directly above the dependency in pom.xml.
      Returns:
      an AddDependencyResult object containing the outcome of each phase.
